title: Execution Proposal
description: execution-proposal/v1: the document an execution-proposal event carries. The pledger proposes how the trade settles: the instruments it created and the terms it built them from. Today that is one loan intent, whose plan carries its own await between the two legs; a later version may propose two DvP intents with an await the facade times between them. The receiver approves or rejects the proposal as a whole, and the pledger answers a rejection with a new proposal.

instrument.description: One intent the pledger created to settle the trade.

type.description: The kind of intent. Only loanIntent is executed today.

terms.description: What the intents were built from, read off the booked trade, so the receiver can check them against the booking.

cash.description: The cash the receiver pays on the first leg.

closeAmount.description: The cash the pledger repays on the second leg.

openTime.description: When the first leg runs, epoch ms.

closeTime.description: When the second leg runs, epoch ms.

collateral.description: The collateral the intents deliver: the trade's lines, or its basket asset.

proposalId.description: This proposal. A later proposal on the same trade is a fresh one, not a revision of this one.

round.description: 1 on the trade's first proposal, incrementing after each rejection.

instruments.description: The intents that settle the trade, in the order they run.
